title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) — Filing, Correction and Submission Limits by Payer Class
content:
Every Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is held to the filing, correction and submission limits of its payer class. The figures below are the schedule Patient Financial Services applies; the rules that use them (timely filing, denial routing, claim-status follow-up) state how each limit is counted.

| Payer class | Timely-filing limit (calendar days from first date of service) | Replacement-claim window (calendar days from adjudication or denial date) | Most replacement claims on one claim | Submission format | 277CA acknowledgement expected within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 180 | 180 | 3 | electronic institutional claim (EDI 837I) | 2 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 120 | 90 | 3 | electronic institutional claim (EDI 837I) | 2 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 180 | 180 | 3 | electronic institutional claim (EDI 837I) | 2 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | 180 | 180 | 3 | electronic institutional claim (EDI 837I) | 2 |
| Original Medicare Claim | 365 | 365 | 3 | electronic institutional claim (EDI 837I) | 2 |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 365 | 365 | 3 | electronic institutional claim (EDI 837I) | 2 |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | 365 | 180 | 2 | paper UB-04 with the medical reports | 10 |

**Settings common to every payer class**
- A front-end rejected submission does not count as received for timely filing, in any payer class.
- A replacement claim carries claim frequency code 7; a claim is voided with claim frequency code 8.
- The documents accepted as proof that a claim was originally filed on time are the clearinghouse acceptance report (277CA) and the payer acknowledgement letter.

**Valid member identifier by payer class**

| Payer class | Member identifier format |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim, Commercial HMO Claim, Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | payer-issued alphanumeric ID as printed on the card |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | plan-issued ID as printed on the plan card (not the MBI) |
| Original Medicare Claim | 11-character Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 10-digit ForwardHealth member ID |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | insurer claim number assigned to the injury |

**Reading the table**
- Which class applies is the payer class shown on the claim itself.
- Example (hypothetical): a Commercial HMO Claim has a 120-day filing limit and a 90-day replacement window; the same service billed as a Commercial PPO Claim would have 180 days for each.
